What this handbook is

A modular DBA toolkit — not a single executable. Use it as a daily health playbook, an on-call first-responder kit, and a consulting deliverable.

How to start (any incident)

  1. Capture evidence first — do not restart, kill, shrink, or rebuild yet.
  2. Note instance / cluster start time (cumulative stats reset on restart).
  3. SQL Server: EXEC dbo.sp_DBA_HealthCheck @DeepDive = 0;
  4. PostgreSQL: SELECT * FROM dba.sp_health_check(deep_dive => false);
  5. Follow the symptom table in the full handbook, then open the matching script here and download it.

How to use this handbook effectively

Junior / first responder

Treat numbered folders as an outside-in path: OS → instance → storage → waits → indexes → HA/DR → security. Open the cheat sheet in Full handbook, then download one script at a time. Prefer read-only files; skip deploy/governance until a senior DBA has signed off.

Senior DBA / consultant

Deploy the framework once per instance/cluster. Use the orchestrator for triage, wrappers for deep dives, and sp_DBA_BaselineCapture / dba.sp_baseline_capture() before and after change. PowerShell and assessment collectors produce shareable HTML/Excel for stakeholders.

Install once (SQL Server)

sqlcmd -S YourServer -d master -i "sql_server/00_Repository/DBARepository_Create.sql" -C
sqlcmd -S YourServer -d DBARepository -i "sql_server/00_Repository/DBARepository_Deploy.sql" -C
sqlcmd -S YourServer -d DBARepository -i "sql_server/00_Repository/DBARepository_Persistence.sql" -C
# or: sql_server/00_Framework/00_Deploy_Framework.ps1 -ServerInstance YourServer -Database DBARepository

Install once (PostgreSQL)

psql -h HOST -U postgres -f postgres/00_Repository/00_create_repository.sql
psql -h HOST -U postgres -d dba_repository -f postgres/00_Framework/00_Deploy_Framework.sql

Safety

  • Diagnostic scripts do not change data. Deploy, baseline capture, and preventive-measures jobs do write.
  • Never create every missing-index suggestion or drop “unused” indexes from a short uptime window.
  • Scope expensive scripts (physical_stats, bloat, fragmentation) with a database list and off-peak windows.

Assessments and extra kits

sql_server_assessment_tool

Phase-1 architectural collector. Detailed: Invoke-SqlInitialAssessment.ps1. Limited: Invoke-SqlInitialAssessment_minimal.ps1.

Choose artifacts with -OutputFormat Html | Excel | Both (alias -o). Log is always written. Excel needs the ImportExcel module.

prod_stats_report

Production database health, missing indexes, and duplicate indexes — complementary to the layered handbook scripts.

PowerShell / HTML generators

sql_server/powershell/Invoke-SqlOptimaAssessment.ps1 and Generate-DBAHandbook.ps1. PostgreSQL: postgres/shell/generate-dba-handbook.sh.

Put this portal on your website

Option A — serve the whole repo (best for browse + download)

Copy this repository to your web root (or a subfolder) so index.html sits next to sql_server/ and postgres/. Then:

<iframe src="https://your.site/dba-handbook/" title="DBA Handbook" style="width:100%;height:100vh;border:0"></iframe>

File view and download use relative URLs, so visitors can open and save scripts.

Option B — GitHub raw files (HTML on one host, files on GitHub)

Host only index.html, then set the file base before other scripts (or edit the config object at the bottom of this file):

<script>
window.HANDBOOK_CONFIG = {
  fileBase: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/__GITHUB_REPO__/__GITHUB_BRANCH__/",
  githubRepo: "__GITHUB_REPO__",
  githubBranch: "__GITHUB_BRANCH__"
};
</script>

Regenerate after repo changes

python docs/build_handbook_portal.py --github-repo __GITHUB_REPO__ --github-branch __GITHUB_BRANCH__

Local preview

python -m http.server 8080
# open http://127.0.0.1:8080/

Opening the file with a file:// URL often blocks in-page preview (browser security). Downloads and GitHub links still work; use a local HTTP server for the viewer.
